text: In Lean 4, the 'induction n with' tactic on n:ℕ generates goals for:
choices: n=0 and the successor case n+1 (with inductive hypothesis)
all n up to a fixed bound
explanation: 'induction n with | zero => ... | succ n ih => ...' generates two cases: base case (n=0) and inductive step (assuming ih: P(n), prove P(n+1)).
